title: Personal Checking: paper statement fee and its age exemption
content:
## Scope

A Personal Checking account whose statement delivery is paper at cycle close may carry a paper statement fee for that statement cycle. This card gives each tier's fee per statement cycle and the age at which primary owners are exempt from it.

## Fee and exemption by tier

| Tier | Paper statement fee per statement cycle (USD) | Primary owners exempt from this age at cycle close (years) |
|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 0.00 | 65 |
| Student Checking | 0.00 | 65 |
| Everyday Checking | 2.00 | 65 |
| Interest Checking | 2.00 | 65 |
| Premier Checking | 0.00 | 65 |
| Private Client Checking | 0.00 | 65 |

The fee column is the fee per statement cycle when statement delivery is paper at cycle close. The exemption column means that primary owners who are at least that age at cycle close are exempt from the paper statement fee.

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Which tiers actually charge for paper statements?**
A: Everyday Checking and Interest Checking, at 2.00 USD per statement cycle. The other four tiers show 0.00.

**Q: An Interest Checking owner is 65 at cycle close and receives paper statements. Is the fee charged?**
A: No. An owner who is at least 65 at cycle close is exempt on every tier.

**Hypothetical boundary**: an Everyday Checking owner aged 64 at cycle close with paper delivery is below the exemption age, so the 2.00 USD figure is the fee that applies to that cycle; the same owner aged 65 at a later cycle close is exempt.
